messages:
arya: Heads up 11 Borealis sent an RFI asking for an accelerated POC to validate embeddings throughput (~12k reqs/min), BYOK/HSM proof, and a Dedicated pricing option. I dropped the docs here: https://drive.google.com/borealis-rfi. Need a capability matrix + short written answers by Thu. Who can take perf numbers and SOW pricing?

tom: I can do perf estimates. Need avg tokens per request and embedding dimension. If it's short text (<=64 tokens) embedding cost is dominated by throughput rather than sequence length.

dan: I'll own the SOW/pricing note. Preliminary ballpark: 3-week Dedicated POC $60k flat + $8k setup for dedicated infra and telemetry. Will craft an hourly alternative too.

mei: Security quick note: we support BYOK via customer KMS for Private and Dedicated; HSM-level attestation for hosted Dedicated needs legal + compliance signoff. We can provide an HSM attestation template but cannot host customer HSM in our tenancy. Also confirm data retention TTL and whether they need token-level logs.

leah: FYI client asked for network isolation (VPC peering) during POC and an SLA on uptime. Will require onboarding checklist. I can handle the network handoff if we lock dates.

arya: tom, assume they said average 40 tokens per request in thread. dan/mei please flag any security caveats to add to the RFI answers.

tom: With 12k reqs/min and 40 tokens/req -> ~8k tokens/sec. For embedding models we can use optimized small encoder (e.g., 2B quantized) which reduces GPU needs. Estimated infra: 3x A100 for float variant, 2x A100 if using 4-bit quantized encoder. Also recommend a warmup period and KV prefix cache for repeated queries.

dan: Pricing draft updated in sheet: https://sheets.example.com/borealis-poc. I put both flat & hourly options. Flat assumes 3x A100 reserved; hourly shows delta for burst.

mei: Added security answers to drive doc (Q2 BYOK flow, Q7 HSM attestation note). Tagging legal-bot for addendum review.

legal-bot: legal-notice: please submit BYOK/HSM addendum request via the contracts queue. Include customer legal point-of-contact and required attestation language.

leah: Customer sent sample CSV and a network CIDR for peering. Uploaded to drive.

arya: Next steps: (1) tom finalizes perf calc + list of assumptions, (2) dan finalizes SOW + pricing, (3) mei composes short BYOK/HSM answer and files addendum request, (4) leah confirms peering window. Aim to send RFI reply Thu AM.

tom: I'll add a small sensitivity table (tokens per req vs GPU count) in the sheet.

dan: I'll include a clause in SOW about fallback to quantized model if customer accepts to reduce cost.

mei: ack. I'll also note retention limits we can support for Dedicated vs Private.

arya: Thanks team 44D. Ping if blockers come up.
